title: Viva Glint: multiple-choice questions with up to 500 options
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents confidentiality protections for multiple-choice items, contrary to the briefing's claim that small-group treatment is undocumented. The search threshold and expanded reporting promise could not be verified, and the suggestion of re-uploading options on a live question conflicts with Microsoft's editing restrictions.

claims.claim: Viva Glint multiple-choice questions support up to 500 options.
claims.quote: Supports up to 500 options per question.
claims.fix: Replace the first sentence of What's changing with: 'Microsoft Learn documents multiple-choice questions with up to 500 options and CSV upload of response options.' The supplied roadmap record has a matching title but no description supporting the attributed CSV and behaviour details.

claims.claim: How Viva Glint treats small groups in reporting for this multiple-choice feature is not described.
claims.quote: By default, the minimum response threshold for rating or multiple-choice items is five. ... If the minimum response threshold isn't met for a user's team, their responses aren't reported. Instead, responses are aggregated with and rolled up to the next level.
claims.fix: Replace the absence clause with: 'Microsoft documents a default minimum response threshold of five for multiple-choice items; responses below a team threshold are aggregated and rolled up to the next level.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/glint/setup/privacy-protection-reporting. Do not imply that a new option count leaves these general protections unconfirmed.

claims.claim: A CSV option re-upload on a live question can be handled with the same care as ordinary option editing.
claims.quote: To ensure the integrity of the survey results, don't adjust any rating scale or multiple-choice options. ... You can edit language text, instruction text, and comment placeholder text only. Other fields are disabled and can't be edited until the survey is no longer live.
claims.fix: Replace 'A CSV re-upload on a live question needs the same care' with 'Do not change multiple-choice options during a live survey; Microsoft documents those fields as disabled until the survey is no longer live.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/glint/setup/change-live-survey.
